Tuple upsert composes external*local; distinct Iso overlap adapter composes parent*(local*external), with existing parent outside native local/external. Existing unchecked UnitQuaternion helper is reused, no new normalization. RaycastMesh::raycast direct behavior is not changed.

Two subworld Rapier index0 values cannot overwrite the same canonical key.
